edits.old: Then no read or write happens before the check
edits.new:
Then no read or write happens before the check

  Scenario: AC14 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key returns the stored answer (R-UNI-40)
    Given a write has committed under an `Idempotency-Key`
    When the same write is replayed with that `Idempotency-Key`
    Then the stored answer is returned
    Then no second flow starts

  Scenario: AC15 A retried or timed-out activity is retried on the workflow's own schedule
    Given an activity of the route start does not finish inside its timeout
    When the workflow retries the activity
    Then the retry runs on the workflow's own schedule
    Then nothing is written while the step waits

  Scenario: AC16 A consumed call that fails or does not answer gives 503 and writes nothing (X6)
    Given a consumed call to rwb-case, rwb-decision or rwb-access fails or does not answer
    When the route start is requested
    Then the caller sees 503 in the platform envelope
    Then nothing is written

  Scenario: AC17 A status change the model does not allow is refused and writes nothing
    Given the case state has no allowed status transition to the route start
    When the route start is requested
    Then the status change is refused
    Then nothing is written
